title: Development of a sensor for the selective detection of manganese in aqueous media using grapefruit peel pectin-decorated silver nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8971-8984
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08769D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Khoa Anh Ton, Khang Nguyen-Duy Dao, Hoa Son Pham, Chi Thi-Kim Huynh, Thu Thi-Cam Nguyen, Phuc Hoang Nguyen, Ty Minh Nguyen, Dung Thi-Kim Hoang
A dispersion of grapefruit pectin-stabilized silver nanoparticles was synthesized via aqueous reduction and applied for Mn2+ detection. Formation of a brown color after one hour confirmed selective sensing of Mn2+ ions.
